desc: Inspired by classic subgun styling and modernized for the rimfire enthusiast, the GSG-16 from German Sport Guns is a blowback-operated .22LR pistol with unmistakable tactical flair. Compact, lightweight, and built for pure fun, this firearm delivers a range-ready experience with minimal recoil and generous capacity. With its distinctive H&K-inspired profile and generous 22-round magazine, the GSG-16 gives shooters an affordable, low-recoil platform perfect for training, plinking, or recreational tactical shooting. Its polymer handguard and adjustable stock-style buffer tube housing offer practical ergonomics and accessory mounting options. The 9.12" barrel strikes a balance between compact maneuverability and accuracy, making this .22LR pistol a versatile choice for all skill levels.
